primary_metric: Sum of measured actual native Cargo (DynamoRIO), rustc, clang and Wild (Cachegrind) dynamic instructions in one complete invocation; separately disclose wrapper/launcher, native ancillary processes, cold fallback, component counts. No claimed wall latency from instrumented execution. Validate ordinary terminal output, oracle audit via same-context JSON outside score, pin registry trust and native compile environment. Do not score unless matching cross-arm native output and instrumented raw ELFs, same exact graph/target keys and complete process roster with terminal success in every observation. Pin Git index, per-arm positive immutable manifest proof stores and treatment verified Git index, all installed binaries, unedited files and C/C++ tool dependencies. Reject changes in inventory across measured observations, unexpected crates, partial instrumentation, corrupt or incompatible reset. Optional dedicated native timed cohort only with complete isolation and preregistered schedule.
decision: 12 pairs per endpoint, six of each order; median percentage of paired reductions; distribution-free 95% median interval, exact two-sided balanced randomization across 924 orders, Holm over the two endpoints, each lower bound >0 and adjusted p<.05. All observations or exclusions retained, publish only if both native/byte/process/cache gates and each endpoint statistical gate pass. Start one independent target at a time; stop after reproducible gate failure if no eligible correction.
